headline: Ramayana is expected to reach 1.05M tickets today and 1.41M tomorrow, with the busiest hour still ahead at 8–9 PM.
bullets: Namit Malhotra's Ramayana: 8–9 PM is expected to be the busiest hour, at 68.4K tickets (range 55.2K–77.7K), and today could total 1.05M (range 878K–1.24M) from 673K so far.

Ramayana is in its opening weekend, so this forecast is drawn from how earlier films behaved on release day and day two, and its range is wide; tomorrow, Saturday, is expected at 1.41M (range 1.05M–1.90M).
Review and rating signals lean Ramayana up (BookMyShow rating +6%, word of mouth +5%, IMDb +3%, critics +2%), but nearly full shows (−18%) cancel that out, leaving a net nudge of 0%.

Aadarsha Kutumbam is expected to peak at 9–10 PM at 1.7K tickets (range 1.4K–2K) and is running 24% ahead of yesterday; Jailer 2 peaks at 8–9 PM at 1.6K (range 1.4K–1.8K) and is running −3% against yesterday.
watch: Shows are almost full at 94% of upcoming shows, so seats rather than demand may cap Ramayana's upside.
Diwali on 8 Nov and the preliminary early ratings could shift tomorrow's Saturday numbers either way.
